Direct system APIs, real-time vision, file orchestration, event-driven autonomy

Evolves the agent into a system-integrated one: API-first (contacts/calendar/battery/settings read directly, 100% reliable), real-time vision (new frame on every UI change), global file orchestration (bulk organize / PDF merge / backups) and event-driven autonomy (battery / schedule / location triggers).
The system_data tool calls Android System APIs directly — no app navigation needed. When a permission is missing, the agent will guide you to grant it in system settings.
Not enabled, tap to open system settings

Behind the live_screen tool is a continuous perception stream: a new frame is captured automatically whenever the UI changes, with periodic refresh when idle. Far faster and fresher than static screenshots for animations and games.
Not granted, tap to open system settings
file_manager and pdf_tools orchestrate the whole storage: bulk sorting, move/rename, search, zip backups and PDF merge/split — no root, structured results.
